Acceptance of Grant of Easement from Azusa Land Reclamation, Inc. Recommendation: Adopt Resolution No. 14-C10 accepting Grant of Easement for the property on Gladstone Street between Mira Loma Drive and Vincent Avenue and authorize the City Clerk to file it in the Office of the Los Angeles County Recorder: A RESOLUTION OF THE UTILITY BOARD/CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AZUSA ACCEPTING A CERTAIN GRANT OF PERMANENT EASEMENT AND DIRECTING THE RECORDING THEREOF.

D-2.2. Reso-ALR Grant of Easement
3.
Award of Contract for Supply and Construction of a Pre-Engineered Shed at the Gladstone Water Yard for Protection of the Hydroexcavator Trucks. Recommendation: Approve award of contract to Pre-Fab Builder, Inc. of Fullerton, CA for supply and construction of a pre-engineered shed for protection of the Water Division's hydroexcavator trucks in the amount of $42,821.00, including tax, delivery, and erection of the building.
D-3.1. Purchase of Storage for Vactor Trucks
D-3.2. W-276 Bid Results
D-3.3. PreFab Builders Proposal
E.
SCHEDULED ITEMS
1.
Declaration of Phase III Water Shortage Restrictions. Recommendation: Pursuant to Azusa Municipal Code Section 78-506, and Rule No. 21 of Azusa Light & Water Rules & Regulations, the Director of Utilities is declaring that a Phase III Water Shortage exists and is communicating the basis for this declaration to the Utility Board. The Phase III Water Shortage goes into effect on May 1, 2014. Utility Board ratification of this declaration is requested.
